import pathlib,json,hashlib
inc=pathlib.Path('/workspace/source/incoming')
print('RECEIPT', (inc/'handoff-receipt.json').read_text())
print('---RESPONSE---')
print((inc/'response.md').read_text())
print('---GUIDE---')
print((inc/'operator-guide.md').read_text())
for n in ['response.md','operator-guide.md']:
 b=(inc/n).read_bytes()
 print(n, len(b), hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
